title: Chicken or Turkey Salad with Creamy Dressing

content.title: About
content.content: Chicken or turkey salad with creamy dressing is a ready‑to‑eat mix of tender cooked poultry pieces, fresh vegetables and a flavorful creamy sauce. Perfect as a light lunch, snack or side dish.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The creamy dressing is usually made from mayonnaise, sour cream or yogurt with added herbs and spices.
Chicken and turkey are lean sources of protein that are easy to digest.
The salad is typically kept chilled to preserve the crunch of the vegetables.
Turkey version is considered slightly more diet‑friendly due to lower fat content.
Herbs such as dill or parsley are often added to the dressing for extra aroma.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Poultry provides complete amino acids that support muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Chicken and turkey are good sources of B6 and B12, essential for nervous system function and blood formation.

items.title: Supports immunity
items.content: The creamy dressing often contains vitamins A and D, which help strengthen the immune system.

items.title: Provides sustained energy
items.content: The combination of protein and healthy fats offers lasting satiety and steady energy levels.

items.title: Provides essential minerals
items.content: The salad supplies potassium, phosphorus and magnesium, important for heart and muscle function.

items.title: Allergy to poultry
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to chicken or turkey, experiencing skin reactions or digestive symptoms.

items.title: High fat content
items.content: Creamy dressings can be calorie‑dense and contain saturated fats; portion control is advised for weight‑watchers.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Prepared dressings often contain added salt, which may be a concern for people with hypertension.

items.title: Shelf life
items.content: The salad must be kept refrigerated and consumed within a few days to prevent bacterial growth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The salad is ready to eat straight from the package. It can be enjoyed on its own, added to a sandwich, used as a filling for wraps, or served alongside whole‑grain bread.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the product in its original packaging in the refrigerator at 0 °C–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3–4 days. Discard if you notice off‑odors or discoloration.
